Joseph Alexander Lawson (27 July 1893 – 14 August 1973) was an Australian politician, elected as a member of the New South Wales Legislative Assembly.

Lawson was born in Kanyapella, Victoria, the fourth child of James Bell Lawson and Mary Beattie, and educated at Deniliquin public school, following a brief period being educated by his grandmother (Johanne Beattie) in Echuca, Victoria. He left school one or two years later (aged about 9), to work on the family farm, but he was an avid reader, with a great love of the Australian poets, Dickens, Burns and many other writers. In his later years, he could still recite a great many poems from memory, not least The Man from Snowy River.  In his early twenties, he bought a mixed farming property, Oakwood, about 6 miles south of Deniliquin. He volunteered for the First AIF in 1915, but despite his fitness he was not accepted, because he had flat feet and two fingers on his left hand joined by a piece of skin.  He married Mary Linus Gain on 12 June 1917 and they had three daughters Mary (known as 'Tib') (dec.), Valda (dec.), and Margaret (dec.) and two sons James (dec.) and George (dec.).

A noted athlete, he played football (Australian Rules Football) and ran as a sprinter in the Victorian Championships and the Stawell Gift. Having been a horse breeder and breaker, he also exhibited prize-winning Clydesdales at the Royal Melbourne Show, as well as having a great interest in horse racing. He became a stock and station agent in Deniliquin in the early 1920s, and was active in the local debating society, the Australian Wheatgrowers Federation, the Pastures Protection Board, the Victorian Producers Co-operative Society, and was a director of the Deniliquin Hospital Board.  He was elected as an alderman of Deniliquin Council from 1925 until 1932 and was mayor from 1931 until 1932.

- Şikâyet formu, Müşteri Hizmetleri tarafından 5 iş günü içinde sisteme taranarak arşivlenir.
- Şikâyet kaydı kapatılmadan önce tüm ekler okunabilirlik açısından kontrol edilir.
- Sistem kesintisi durumunda işlemler elle tutulan çizelgeye yazılır ve sonra sisteme aktarılır.
- Süreçle ilgili eğitimler yılda en az bir kez tekrarlanır.
- Onay zinciri tutara göre birikimli belirlenir — 30.000 TL ve altı: birim yöneticisi; 30.000 TL üstü ve 40.000 TL ve altı: birim yöneticisi + bölüm müdürü; 40.000 TL üstü: birim yöneticisi + bölüm müdürü + genel müdür yardımcısı.
- Yönetici, izinli olduğu günlerde yetkisini yazılı olarak bir vekile devreder.
- Kayıt üzerinde yapılan her değişiklik, değişikliği yapan kullanıcının adıyla günlüğe yazılır.
- Şikâyet kaydı ile ilgili tüm yazışmalar Hukuk Müşavirliği ortak kutusuna kopyalanır.
- Şikâyet Yönetimi, süreçle ilgili soruları 7 iş günü içinde yanıtlamakla yükümlüdür.
- Müşteri Hizmetleri ile Hukuk Müşavirliği arasındaki devirler devir formu ile belgelenir.
- Kayıtlarda kısaltma kullanılmaz; açıklamalar tam cümle olarak yazılır.
- Fatura kopyası aslı istenmeden önce taranmış kopyası kabul edilebilir.
- Telefonla alınan talepler aynı gün içinde yazılı kayda dönüştürülür.

İyi çalışmalar.

Attachment – related record
Subject: Shipment

Hello Mia,

Due to an office move, some files were temporarily moved to another floor. An automatic acknowledgement was sent to the record owner. Daniel Hall used their corporate e-mail address in the exchange. Two new staff members started induction this week. A new briefing session is planned for Claims staff. The team lead has just returned from annual leave. Olivia Martin said the information text was easy to understand. Call notes were entered into the system shortly afterwards. System announcements were refreshed on the home page.

The record details are below:
Record ID → SVK-92727
Service → cold chain
Destination → international
Delay → 198 hours
Parcel weight → 48.3 kg
Documents received → invoice, proof of delivery

Jack Turner thanked the team at the end of the call. The Operations Hub manager could not attend the weekly review. Aaron Parker mentioned that a colleague might ask a similar question. Liam Davies recalled that proactive customer notification was done last month for a different shipment; that record is unrelated to this file. The large-font option was used on the record screen. The menu order on the department's phone line was changed. The team reorganised the shared folder. Ruby Walker said they liked the new screen layout. Because of the rain, the face-to-face meeting was held online. The record was created during business hours.

Reminder — rules that apply:
- Customer communications are written in plain language using the corporate template.
- Internal audit samples records from this process once a year.
- A shipment is eligible for fast-track handling only if ALL of the following hold: (1) the service is 'standard'; (2) the delay is at most 150 hours; (3) the destination is 'international'; (4) the delivery note has been received; (5) the parcel weight is at most 30.0 kg.
- A scanned copy of the proof of delivery may be accepted before the original is requested.
- When on leave, the specialist delegates authority to a deputy in writing.
- Every change to the record is logged with the name of the user who made it.
- Personal data is viewed and shared only to the extent the task requires.
- Operations Hub must answer process questions within 2 business days.
- The invoice is scanned and archived by Claims within 3 business days.
- During a system outage, actions are logged on a manual sheet and entered later.
- The automated system reviews the list of open shipments every week and adds notes where needed.
- Handovers between Claims and Operations Hub are documented with a handover form.
- Requests received by phone are converted into a written record on the same day.
- Training on this process is repeated at least once a year.
- The current version of the forms used in this process is published on the intranet.
- Abbreviations are not used in records; explanations are written as full sentences.
- Before any shipment is closed, all attachments are checked for legibility.
- Operations Hub owns this procedure and approves any changes to it.
- If several records exist for the same matter, the oldest one is used as the master record.

Kind regards.
